item.title: Barracuda XDR - Service Disruption on Email events ingestion [resolved]
item.description:
We have successfully completed the scheduled system upgrade for the Email Security Events ingestion service in the US region. During the upgrade window, there was a temporary disruption in event ingestion from 06/22/2026 22:48:50 UTC to 06/23/2026 00:06:00 UTC.
We acknowledge the potential impact this interruption may have had on your business operations and would like to assure you that the service has now been fully restored and is operating normally.
